references.inspection: Full local statue original inspected: seated figure, broad chair, left closed hand/right relaxed hand, long coat, separated bent legs, short beard and plinth. A simplified original silhouette is intended, not a portrait-quality replica.
references.use: Geometry reference only; no photo pixels embedded.

sources.facts: NPS dimensions control colonnade 188 ft 4 in by 118 ft 6 in, 44 ft column height and 7 ft 5 in diameter; 36 plus two entrance columns; 20 flutes; 19 ft seated statue and 10 ft pedestal.

sources.inspection: Individually inspected rendered PDF pages 110, 111 and 113 (printed 108, 109, 111): east elevation, longitudinal section and statuary chamber plan dated 2008. They resolve the raised terrace, two upper stair flights, central opening, column layout and recessed roof.
sources.facts: Outer colonnade has 12 columns across each long face and eight across each short face, sharing corners. Separate upper marble and lower granite flights are divided by a landing. Site approaches and reflecting-pool stairs remain outside model scope.

notes: Earlier photo selection is historical provenance. Current construction uses two inventoried exact public-domain exterior originals. NPS factual dimensions/plan references retained; original seated silhouette unchanged and no new portrait work.
